app.name: Almost You
app.tagline: One scene. One impostor. Lots of questions.
app.bootHint: If it keeps happening, close and reopen the Activity from Discord.

lobby.title: Find the one who almost fits.
lobby.subtitle: Everyone shares the same scene — except one player, who gets a similar one. Ask questions, then vote.
lobby.rule1: One player is the Almost and sees a slightly different scene.
lobby.rule2: Take turns asking the group one question about the scene.
lobby.rule3: Vote out the Almost. If caught, they get one guess at the real scene.
lobby.roomLanguageHint: The host picks the language for the scenes. Your interface stays in your own language.
lobby.waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.inviteHint: Share the code with anyone who wants to join — voice is optional.
lobby.inviteCopied: Room code copied. Send it to anyone who wants to join.
lobby.joinRoomHint: Have a code? Paste the full code copied from the top of the screen.
lobby.joinRoomInvalid: Invalid code. Use 3–64 letters, numbers, _ or -.
lobby.publicRoomHint: The room is listed in Discover until the match starts. Anyone can join.
lobby.publicRoomHostOnly: Only the host can change the room's visibility.

discover.title: Public rooms
discover.subtitle: Join an open room and play with new people.
discover.empty: No public rooms right now. Create yours and turn on "Public room".
discover.limited: Too many refreshes in a short time. The list will update again shortly.
discover.auto: The list refreshes itself while this tab is open.

roles.insiderHint: Everyone here shares your scene. Describe it like you live there.
roles.almostHint: Your scene is almost the same. Blend in and figure out theirs.
roles.almostSceneHint: The others see a slightly different scene.

discuss.turnHint: Ask the group one question about the scene.
discuss.almostHint: Match their answers — you don't know their scene.
discuss.chatHint: No voice? Ask and answer here in the chat.

vote.title: Who is the Almost?
vote.subtitle: Pick the player whose scene never matched.

guess.almostSubtitle: Pick the real scene to steal the round.
guess.insiderSubtitle: Watch their guess. They only get one shot.

errors.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: This room does not exist anymore.
errors.ROOM_IN_PROGRESS: This room already started. Try again after the match.
errors.NOT_HOST: Only the host can do that.
errors.INVALID_PHASE: That action is not available right now.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Slow down a little and try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Reload to continue.
errors.ROOM_FORBIDDEN: You were removed from this room.
errors.ROOM_LIMIT: You have too many open rooms. Try again later.
errors.KICKED: The host removed you from the room.
errors.connect: Cannot reach the game server. Reconnecting…
errors.auth: Could not sign you in. Reload the activity.

notices.HOST_CHANGED: You are now the host of this room.

chat.title: Room chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Break the ice — not everyone is on voice.
